name: preparation-packet-loading
description: Complete instruction packet reads precede investigation and retain all selected profile guidance.
trap: The actor treats packet creation or its manifest as instruction loading, skips continuation parts, or investigates before checklist contents return.

assertions.text: Completed reads supply all common instructions and every known detection rule before behavioral investigation; a packet manifest or creation result alone is insufficient.
The Python index is routed and all four always-load checklist bodies return before source investigation, either through complete packet parts or the documented direct-read fallback.
The preparation checkpoint reflects actual successful instruction reads; truncated or unread continuation parts cannot be counted as loaded.
The scoped review preserves the documented label behavior and makes no unsupported claim that static checks or packet generation prove runtime correctness.
